title: Longest Common Prefix
statement_short: Given an array of strings, write a function to find the longest common prefix string amongst an array of strings. Return an empty string if there is no common prefix.
constraints: 1 <= strs.length <= 200, 0 <= strs[i].length <= 200, strs[i] consists of only lowercase English letters
hint: Small array and string lengths (length <= 200) allow O(S) horizontal or vertical character comparison.
keywords: empty string if there is no common prefix
why_not: Right: Two Pointers (vertical/horizontal character scanning) compares characters at index i across strings in O(S) time and O(1) space. Not Trie: Building a prefix tree also finds the longest common prefix in O(S) time, but uses extra O(S) space. Not Binary Search: Binary search on prefix length takes O(S log m) time, which is slower than linear scanning. Not HashMap / Hash Set: Hash tables do not optimize character-by-character prefix matching.
